basic_details.job_title: IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Coordinator and Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Management Shillong (IIM Shillong)
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Management Shillong (IIM Shillong) has officially announced the Project Coordinator / Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 with 3 openings on a contractual basis. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.iimshillong.ac.in/. Candidates holding a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Management, Rural Development, Social Sciences, or another relevant discipline, as applicable to the respective post, are eligible to submit their applications via email up to 07 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and application

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in Management, Rural Development, or a relevant discipline, Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Management, Rural Development, Social Sciences, or a related discipline
qualification.details: Project Coordinator: Master's Degree in Management, Rural Development, or a relevant discipline. Experience in enterprise promotion, startup incubation, livelihood programmes, entrepreneurship development, rural development projects, or related areas. Knowledge of local languages of Meghalaya will be an added advantage. Field Investigator: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Management, Rural Development, Social Sciences, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred). Experience in community-based development work, surveys, or field research will be preferred. Fresh postgraduates with demonstrated capability and willingness to undertake extensive fieldwork may also apply.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 45,000 per month for Project Coordinator, Rs. 34,000 per month for Field Investigator
salary_details.details: Project Coordinator: Rs. 45,000 per month Field Investigator: Rs. 34,000 per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Shillong Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIM Shillong Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Shillong recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the IIM Shillong recruitment is 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Coordinator and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies. One vacancy is for the Project Coordinator post, and two vacancies are for the Field Investigator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Coordinator position?
faq.answer: For the Project Coordinator position, a Master's Degree in Management, Rural Development, or a relevant discipline is required, along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Field Investigator post is Rs. 34,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIM Shillong recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tentative date for the interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the interview is 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIM Shillong offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for IIM Shillong recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
